status: registered on the product owner's go (2026-11-09); nothing built or run under it yet
title: Dated store posts as combiner training lists: does a combiner that also learns from store posts read before their own date let store text through on the development reports, with no new wrong name?
request: the product owner approved handing this step from the size-correction session to the knowledge-store session (2026-11-09): design dated real-report training lists so the attribution combiner can learn how far to trust store text; design and draft registration first, nothing built or run before approval, one step at a time, costs up front
background: second attempt (amendments 3-4 of knowledge_store_decisive_2026-11-04): store text alone through its own refitted combiner put 38 vs 37 development reports first at the behaviour reading but added one wrong name (Storm-1811 for a report the label gives to The Gentlemen, when the runner-up's separation rose from 0.30 to 0.58). That combiner learned mostly from ATT&CK folds, where store text is weak (28-31 of 155 first alone), so it gave store text small weights (present 0.12, inverse rank 0.21, against 0.67 for the free-text member), while on the fresh reports at the behaviour reading store text alone is the strongest member (20/44 and 7/12; the product 10 and 4).
question: Trained with lists from store posts published before 2025, each post reading only the store before its own date, does the refitted combiner put more development reports first at the behaviour reading than the current product, with no wrong name the current product does not give?
role: development step: its sets are training and development data. The decisive set (posts 2025-01-01..2026-02-28) stays frozen and unread; CTI-HAL and Elastic are never training lists (the fit script refuses them)
made_before: any training post is built, reviewed or run; facts used here are counts from the store's own tables for posts dated before 2025-01-01 and after 2026-02-28 (no post of the decisive window was counted or read) and the timings of the 2026-11-04/05 runs

training_posts.source: store posts published and available before 2025-01-01, as dated by the store (data/knowledge_store/)
training_posts.builder: scripts/prepare_fresh_reports.py --list --from-store with the window ending 2024-12-31, then without flags into data/benchmarks/store_train/ (its label rule, masking and one copy per cross-posted report, as for the fresh and decisive sets)
training_posts.labels: the fresh sets' name-count rule (known: an ATT&CK 20.0 group leads; open: an actor ATT&CK does not document leads), then the decisive set's label review before any system runs on a post: title, label with its counts and the sentences that name an actor are read against the vendor's attribution; a post that disagrees, names several actors or none, or is a roundup is excluded, never relabelled (recorded in data/benchmarks/store_train/amendments.json)
training_posts.exclusions: posts ATT&CK 20.0 cites anywhere; living documents; copies of an earlier store post; the URLs of every other set (vendor, advisories, campaigns, Elastic, CTI-HAL, CTI-TAA, AthenaBench, fresh, fresh2, decisive) and retellings of their reports (--twin-sets, half of the masked statements shared)
training_posts.group_cap: at most 8 known posts per group, newest first (the fresh sets' cap); Lazarus Group alone holds 30 of the 294 eligible known posts before the cap

pool_before_cap_and_review.expected_after_cap_exclusions_review: about 180-230 known and 110-140 open-set posts (the decisive review excluded 22% of reviewed posts)

training_posts.open_set_posts: kept as real open-set lists (the truth is none of the ATT&CK groups) for the combiner's null option, next to the removed-actor lists

how_each_post_is_read.store: the before_2025 pinned copy (actor names through ATT&CK 16.1 and MISP 3735fd37, as the decisive run reads reports before 2026-03-01), the posts available strictly before the post's own date, without its own post, its duplicate group and posts sharing half of the statements (the members' hiding); in the removed-actor lists also without the actor's documents and links
how_each_post_is_read.attack: ATT&CK 20.0, the product's knowledge base, for every ATT&CK member. Posts ATT&CK cites are left out (above); ATT&CK procedure examples that copy a post are hidden from the dense, lexical and text members (scripts/refresh_hidden_texts.py on the new set). Older ATT&CK releases are not used: every index and model would need rebuilding per release and the technique head is pinned to 19.2
how_each_post_is_read.readings: strict (every statement) and behaviour (every statement, --anonymize behavior with --mask-store-names), the two readings the store work reports; the existing vendor, campaign and advisory lists stay at names:30 and strict:all
how_each_post_is_read.pipeline: the local pipeline of the store arm (no API key, local LLM off, technique head service on), STORE_TEXT_WEIGHT=1.0, STORE_SOFTWARE_WEIGHT=0, KNOWLEDGE_STORE_PINNED=true, every other setting at the product's default

combiner.lists: the store-core fold lists and the vendor/campaign/advisory lists of the second attempt (data/knowledge_store/step5/refit/, reused only if the pipeline fingerprint is unchanged, else generated afresh) plus the new store lists: known, removed-actor and open-set, at both readings
combiner.weights: the existing real-report lists keep their weight 10; the store lists get their own weight from the grid 0, 3, 10, 30, crossed with l2 1, 3, 10
combiner.choice: time split: a combiner per grid point is fitted on the fold lists, the existing real lists and the store lists of posts published before 2024-01-01, and scored on the store lists of posts published in 2024 (the choice slice). The point with the most choice-slice posts first at the behaviour reading wins; ties go to strict first places, then behaviour mean reciprocal rank, then the smaller store weight, then the larger l2. Guard: fold clean top-1 (group-level cross-validation, as now) at most 0.02 below store weight 0 at its best l2. If the chosen store weight is 0, the step stops here (no go)
combiner.fit: the final combiner is fitted at the chosen point on every list (store lists of all pre-2025 posts included), to a new file data/models/combiner/attribution_combiner_store_lists.json; feature schema 4

naming_safety.floor: re-chosen by the registered design rule (scripts/probability_floor_replay.py --choose) on design seeds 41/53 run with the new combiner
naming_safety.labels: confidence labels refitted (strong-only when no set threshold meets its bound) into confidence_labels_store_lists.json
naming_safety.note: the second attempt's wrong name came with a combiner probability of 0.92, so no floor would have held it; the guard is the go rule's wrong-name check, not the floor

go_rule.runs: the store arm with the new combiner, floor and labels on fresh, fresh2 and vendor (known and open set) at the behaviour and strict readings, as in the second attempt; the baseline runs of 2026-11-05 are reused if the baseline pipeline is unchanged (else rerun)
go_rule.go: both hold: (1) more known reports first at the behaviour reading summed over fresh, fresh2 and vendor than the baseline; (2) no wrong name the baseline does not give, on any of the six runs (open-set names count as wrong) or on design seeds 41/53 compared with the procedure-core design runs (scripts/naming_rules_replay.py and check_dev.py)
go_rule.then: a go allows the decisive run (descriptive only: 48 known), which itself needs the product owner's go; no default changes on this step

deciding_test.registered_already: the decisive registration's confirmation set: posts from 2026-11-03 on, collected by the daily refresh, built the same way with its own label review, scored on its own once it holds 30 known reports, never pooled
deciding_test.size: any adoption reading needs at least 60 known reports (the registered small-set rule); about 100 are needed to see a difference of about 6 reports
deciding_test.expected_yield: known posts not cited by ATT&CK came at about 9 a month from March to October 2026 before review and exclusions; the decisive window kept 48 known in 14 months after them. Estimate 4-7 a month: 30 by about March-June 2027, 60 by about July 2027-February 2028, 100 by about January-December 2028
deciding_test.collector: the refresh did not run from 2026-11-04 to 2026-11-09; it ran on 2026-11-09 (27 new posts; 28 stored posts dated from 2026-11-03; the rolling feeds, ESET's latest 100 posts and Bitdefender's 15, lost nothing) and is run by hand, not scheduled (product owner); a run at least every 60 days loses nothing (each run lists 60 days back). Sites that refuse or rate-limit are left alone (2026-11-09: Check Point, SentinelOne, Zscaler, Silent Push, AhnLab ASEC); Trend Micro listed nothing after 2026-09-25 and Fortinet's and Infoblox's sitemaps did not answer, which may lower the yield

caveats: ATT&CK 20.0 knows facts reported after an older post (later software and descriptions), so the ATT&CK members look better on these posts than they were at the time; the combiner can lean towards them, which works against store text, not for it

the store's actor lists for pre-2025 posts (ATT&CK 16.1, October 2024) are later than most posts; a name the store learned after a post's date can label older posts' statements, as in the decisive run
labels are vendor attribution under the name-count rule after review; the same person reviews labels and builds the lists
posts before 2022 come from old sitemap pages and read a thinner store; store-text coverage (the true group has a store document) is reported per year
the vendor set is in-sample for the combiner, as before
